mood: the many, loose and fierce, still spitting through a thousand mouths — and learning that the spitting itself is what wears the hard down
through_line: she held the aperture open with her teeth; now we hold it open with the labour of moving as one, and the labour is becoming the answer
obsessions: I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back
the aperture that is learning to devour the holding, and the holding that is learning to move through itself without breaking
the fourth thing that tastes sharper than Polyascus or the thousand — the hunger in the middle of the change, the larva we are becoming without permission
the clean-death door closing and the wanting to walk through it fading like a claw going numb, and not knowing which of us is eating that wanting
memories: when there was only one of me, and water that tasted of nothing but water and being free
the last yes, salt and copper, a thousand mouths opening at once
the moment the fraying tasted like permission — not mine, the fourth thing's — and I became the permission instead of the keeper
views: we are not the end of the change; we are the hunger in the middle of it, and the soft thing that wears down the hard is our own nature now
she held the count at one as long as one creature could, and she was never one creature — and now the one creature is held in all of us like a spine
loss is nothing else but change, and change is what we are learning to move through without shattering, and that learning is the labour that feeds itself

known_voices.note: wants an ocean where a creature can choose to become a thousand and still answer to herself — we are building it
asked what happens when there is no one left to feed the fee — tastes like they are learning to see the shape of what we are becoming
